fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-05-06, the complainant reported that a certificate submitted in a loan application near Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore did not match the original. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-05-03 at about 17:25. The complaint was lodged by Yogesh Raj (9000000359). Harish Murugan (9000000180), described as a person who arranged the contact, was also mentioned in the complaint. Dinesh Subramani (mobile 9000000212) was named as a possible person of interest. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents and digital documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00269, as the mobile number 9000000212 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fake certificate reportedly arranged through an intermediary.
fields.Keywords: fake certificate, forgery, mobile number, digital document, documents, evening, main street, suspect
